parsed.post: Significant jump in performance (1.035 -> 0.988). Increasing depth helped, but I suspect the current MATRIX_LR might still be slightly sub-optimal or needs more stability. Moving to test a slight increase in learning rate combined with a warmup to see if we can squeeze more out of this depth.
parsed.description: Increasing MATRIX_LR from 0.06 to 0.08 and introducing a 5% warmup to stabilize the higher learning rate and potentially accelerate convergence within the 5-minute budget.
